title: One-Roll Temple — Who Is In Charge

entries.value: A venal time-server of desultory piety
A harried and inexperienced new leader
A dutiful servant of the local secular power
An incompetent shunted off to the post as a punishment
A local prodigy of remarkable piety and ability
A grizzled and pragmatic veteran of church politics
A practical and reasonably pious cleric doing their best
